overall_summary: The channel's clear growth engine is the 'What If You Fell Into...' space survival format, which consistently generates 800-1,000+ views per video. In contrast, standard psychology facts and short-form brain trivia are severely underperforming, rarely breaking 100 views. Transitioning existing high-performing space facts into first-person 'What If' survival narratives is the most immediate path to scaling views.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person 'What If You Fell Into...' Space Survival Narratives
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,012 views) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (970 views) are the top performers on the channel.
winning_patterns.action: Adopt this framing as the primary template for all space and planetary content, converting passive facts into active, high-stakes survival scenarios.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on extreme conditions like 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (721 views) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (1,025 views) perform exceptionally well even in standard fact formats.
winning_patterns.action: Combine these extreme planetary topics with the 'What If' survival framing to maximize viewer retention and click-through rates.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' generated as low as 5 to 10 views across multiple uploads, and 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' got only 17 views.
weak_patterns.action: De-prioritize psychology and brain facts, shifting creative resources entirely toward cosmic mysteries and survival storytelling.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'The Only Animal That Can Live Forever' (69 views) and 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (118 views) struggle to gain traction compared to the longer 19-21 second space videos.
weak_patterns.action: Increase average video duration to 19-21 seconds to allow for deeper narrative tension and immersive sound design.

next_video.reason: This concept merges the highly successful 'What If You Fell Into...' narrative framework with the proven high-interest topic of 'Supersonic Rubies' (which previously achieved 721 views as a standard fact video).
